about_the_game:
The Arcade Rhythm Game Legend—Now in Your Hands

PUMP IT UP R!SE brings the legendary arcade rhythm game experience to PC for the first time. As the official adaptation of the beloved PUMP IT UP series, it’s built on over 25 years of rhythm game history and passion.

The game’s iconic step-based gameplay has been reimagined for hand controls and tailored for keyboard, gamepad, and Steam Deck—offering a fresh yet familiar way to feel the beat.

Whether you're a total beginner or a seasoned rhythm master, the rebalanced difficulty system ensures a smooth, rewarding experience for everyone.

What Makes It Pump


    []

    Handcrafted Charts for Keyboard, Gamepad, and More

    Step charts have been carefully rebuilt to match the feel of hand input—bringing the iconic timing and impact of the arcade to your fingertips. Play from 5-key “Single” to 6-key “Half Double” modes, each crafted for precision and rhythm.

    [/]

    []

    Three Core Game Modes

    WARM UP – Play any track, anytime, in a no-pressure practice mode.

    DIVISION – Climb the ranks by competing against players of similar skill levels.

    CHALLENGE – Push yourself through a structured, 10-tier skill test to prove your rhythm prowess.

    [/]

    []

    200+ Songs at Launch, 400+ Planned

    From series staples like “Beethoven Virus,” “Turkish March,” and “Canon D,” to original hits from the latest versions—over 200 tracks come packed in at launch.
    And with regular updates and seasonal DLC, the library is set to grow to over 400 songs post-release.

    [/]

    []

    Steam Deck Ready, Built to Play Anywhere

    From day one, R!SE was developed with the Steam Deck in mind. Whether you’re playing with a keyboard, a gamepad, or on the go, enjoy a smooth and responsive rhythm game experience wherever you are.

    [/]

  • Processor: Intel® Core i3-4150 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GTX 750 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel® Core i5-8500 or better

  • Graphics: Nvidia® GTX 1050 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Storage: 40 GB available space
